nonBlocking.issue: Confirmed, incomplete H4 fix: `if kind in {"button", "submit", "hidden"}: continue` skips required button-based comboboxes. A required, empty `<button role="combobox">` produces `ok: true`, allowing submission with Country unanswered. The same probe passes incorrectly on base, so this is non-blocking.

Confirmed, incomplete H2 parity: `path = re.sub(r"/+$", "", parts.path) or "/"` omits WHATWG URL canonicalization. For `https://jobs.example.com/café`, Python preserves `café` while the worker returns `caf%C3%A9`; dot segments and internationalized hosts also differ. Gate 1 can miss the worker's canonical Link. These mismatches also exist on base.

Confirmed: `not s.get("ok")` still marks successful Gate 1 and Gate 2 send steps as failures because they expose `approved` and `sent`, respectively. An all-success mocked run returns `success: false`. This patch fixes the Pipeline step's flag but leaves these two; base also returns false.

Confirmed, incomplete H8 safeguard: `PLACEHOLDER_RE` rejects `you@example.com` but accepts the shipped `alex.candidate@example.com` template unchanged. Copying the example to filler-profile.json enables live filling with its fictional identity and personal answers. This remains non-blocking against the base's unconditional hardcoded identity.

Confirmed implementation-pinning test: the shim checks require a particular import spelling and `len(twin.splitlines()) < 30`. Removing the call to main would leave these assertions green, while harmless formatting can fail them. Exercise both CLI entrypoints with synthetic inputs and compare behavior instead.
